Q & A Dental Care

01

The homepage hero is 2.8 MB

The first-screen background dentist-macedonia-q-a-dental-2.webp is the measured LCP element and weighs 2,799,632 bytes; Google's mobile lab scored 54/100 with a 28.03-second simulated LCP.

  • Optimize that exact hero while preserving quality, and serve suitably sized mobile and desktop versions without downloading both.
  • Retest after the image change; review blocking Oxygen CSS, jQuery dependencies and the duplicated Poppins request without blindly delaying essential files.
02

The live open-status uses wrong hours

The homepage's open-status script uses Friday 9–1 and Saturday 9–12, while the exact Google profile and visible website table say Friday 8–1 and Saturday closed.

  • Change Friday in weeklyHours to [[8,13]] and Saturday to []; keep America/New_York and the correct visible hours table.
  • Test Friday before 9 AM and Saturday morning in local browser time, without changing the live profile; keep the Friday administrative-hours note.
03

Business and author schema need correction

The checked site has no local Dentist entity, and all 44 Article nodes label Q & A Dental Care as a Person rather than a business.

  • Add one verified Dentist entity using the correct business details and hours; retain accurate existing schema.
  • Use Organization for practice authorship, or a confirmed named individual where they actually authored or reviewed the article; no Product pricing needs deletion here.
04

Utility pages are listed for search

Coming Soon and Thank You both return 200, lack noindex, and appear in the XML sitemap.

  • Noindex the thank-you page and preserve its form-confirmation role; retire the coming-soon page if unused, otherwise noindex it.
  • Remove both utility URLs from the XML sitemap rather than redirecting useful form confirmations to the homepage.
05

One article names the wrong city

The full-mouth rehabilitation article's First Consultation section says “our dentist in Poway” even though this practice is in Macedonia, Ohio.

  • Replace Poway with Macedonia, OH in that paragraph and review the rest of this article for copied location details.
06

Three Call buttons open a form instead

Three homepage buttons labeled Call in the no-insurance, benefits and services sections link to Request an Appointment instead of starting a call.

  • Make #link_text-66-83, #link_text-387-83 and #link_text-418-83 call the appropriate displayed number, preserving dynamic call tracking.
  • Alternatively, rename those buttons Request an Appointment if the form is the intended action; verify the text and destination agree on mobile.

Fix order

First correct the open-status and Call actions, then improve the hero and clean up schema, utility indexing and the wrong-city paragraph.

  • Website: hours script, button actions, hero delivery, schema and utility-page settings.
  • Content: correct the city and add useful body links from existing educational guides to the relevant service pages.

Read-only audit: no website, GBP or indexing changes and no new Q&A tickets. Performance is lab data; field metrics were unavailable and the repeat was cached.
